step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Talabat's cloud migration and modernization strategy from an on-premises data center to AWS. On-premises applications and databases are migrated using two strategies: re-architecting critical/less-complex workloads into containerized services on EKS and serverless functions on Lambda, and re-platforming complex workloads into AWS Elastic Beanstalk. A central router (DNS / Route 53) manages weighted traffic shifting between on-premises and AWS components for high availability during transition. On the database tier, AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) migrates data from proprietary databases to Amazon Aurora, while lift-and-shift database instances run on EC2 to support Elastic Beanstalk applications.

graph.name: Talabat Cloud Migration and Application Modernization Architecture
graph.notes: Talabat serves over 500,000 orders per day across the MENA region. The architecture demonstrates a dual-track migration path: re-architecting applications to Amazon EKS and AWS Lambda, alongside re-platforming to AWS Elastic Beanstalk with Amazon EC2 hosted databases for speed during peak periods like COVID-19.
